verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents a built-in assistant, Amplitude AI, that answers plain-language questions across your data [amplitude-docs-10]. It also offers conversational, expert-level answers without SQL or building dashboards [amplitude-docs-34]. This is question-answering rather than clearly documented task delegation. The embeddable end-user agent [amplitude-docs-26] and the MCP server for external AI tools are different capabilities and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented ability to hand the in-product assistant multi-step tasks (e.g., building charts, dashboards or cohorts on your behalf), in-depth docs on the assistant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
